summary_markdown: The team discussed data requirements following a response from Accurat. It was determined that to answer the request for 'specific month' data, the available external data must align with the period when internal sensors are installed and live. Assuming the Proof of Concept (POC) is confirmed in September, the sensors would be installed and operational in October, meaning Accurat data for October will be required.
decisions: Accurat data for October is needed to correlate with sensor installation dates.
action_items: [p2] will communicate this requirement to Accurat.
